{{Quote|See that large building? That's your command center.|Qui-Gon Jinn, to the Wookiee workers|audio=ISpyCommandCenter.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] workers built a '''command center''' on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. The command center was one of the early bases built on Alaris Prime during the Wookiees' [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization]] effort on the moon. At the building, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] taught the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] how to gather four vital materials for the colony: [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]], and [[Ore/Legends|ore]]. The Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] also [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|defended]] the base from an attack by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]] on Alaris Prime.

==Description==
{{Quote|When workers are in trouble, they can run to the command center for shelter. They can even shoot at invaders from the command center.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=WorkerInstruct.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
A command center was built on [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]], by [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] workers during their [[Species/Legends|species]]' [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization attempt]] on the moon. The building was equipped with a [[Autoturret/Legends|turret]] that could be manned by Wookiee workers if the command center came under attack. A large and impenetrable [[Tree/Legends|forest]] covered the north and west sides of the building, and a [[Water/Legends|river]] ran to the east of it. The command center was close to many resources; several [[Muja fruit/Legends|muja fruit]] bushes had grown near the building, and a short distance away were deposits of [[Nova crystal/Legends|nova crystals]] and [[Ore/Legends|ore]], which could be used as a form of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] and processed into [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]], respectively.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==History==
{{Quote|I sense trouble&hellip; gundarks are approaching!|Qui-Gon Jinn alerts the Wookiees to the gundark attack|audio=TU2-WNARN-L56.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
Wookiee workers constructed the command center on Alaris Prime<ref name="SW:GB" /> between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[39 BBY/Legends|39]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]].<ref name="NEC" /> The building served as one of the first bases erected on the [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovered]] moon during the Wookiee colonization effort there. [[Unidentified Wookiee worker|Three]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 2|Wookiee]] [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 3|workers]] were stationed at the command center, where they were instructed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], who had been sent by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to oversee the colonization effort, on how to gather several different resources.<ref name="SW:GB" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|option=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
The Wookiees began by gathering [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] from the nearby muja fruit bushes. After a sufficient amount of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] had been harvested, [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 4|another]] Wookiee worker arrived at the base and was instructed by Jinn to catch [[Fish/Legends|fish]] from the river as another source of food for the colony. More food was gathered and [[Unidentified Wookiee worker 5|another]] Wookiee arrived to assist.<ref name="SW:GB" />

[[File:Underattack.png|thumb|left|200px|The command center under attack]]
Following the arrival of the fifth worker, Jinn decided to conduct a drill in case the command center was attacked by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a predatory species on Alaris Prime, or any other kind of enemy. The drill involved stopping all of the workers' activity and sending the Wookiees into the command center for their protection. The drill was pulled off successfully, and the workers were then sent back to work. Eventually, enough food had been gathered to sustain the colony, meaning the workers could turn their attention to gathering [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]], another necessary resource for the colony's survival, as it could be processed into [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]], which could be used for buildings. Jinn instructed the workers on how to gather carbon from the trees that stood near the command center. A short [[Time/Legends|time]] later, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], one of the Wookiee leaders of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]], arrived at the base.<ref name="SW:GB" />

At the same time as the Wookiee arrived, a group of four gundarks began to [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|attack]] the command center. The workers went into the command center in a similar fashion that they had practiced in the drill and used the building's turret system to defend the base from the gundarks. With assistance from Chewbacca, the Wookiees were able to [[Death/Legends|kill]] the gundarks and prevent the command center from suffering serious damage. Following the attack, Chewbacca explored the area near the command center and found the stockpiles of ore and nova, and the workers collected enough of the various resources to sustain the base.<ref name="SW:GB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Click on your command center, then click on the create Wookiee worker button in the lower left corner of the screen.|Qui-Gon Jinn, instructing the player|audio=CreateWorker.flac|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
The Wookiee command center was first mentioned in the [[Prima Games]]' [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] by [[Steven L. Kent]],<ref name="Prima">[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>&mdash;released on [[November 7]], [[2001]]<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref>&mdash;for the [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'',<ref name="SW:GB" /> released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref> The command center appears in the second level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign, "Gathering Resources," in which it is the only building in the player's base. The command center is used in the level for containing the resources collected by the player, creating new workers and housing them when the base is attacked by gundarks. In the level, it is the player's choice of the order they collect the resources. This article follows the instructions given by Qui-Gon Jinn, which are to first gather food, and when 200 food has been gathered by the workers, collect carbon, and then the player has to explore the area to find nova crystals and ore to gather. The level ends once 200 food, 100 carbon, fifty nova crystals, and fifty ore have been gathered, but the player can also lose the level if the command center is destroyed in the gundark attack or if all their workers are killed.<ref name="SW:GB" />
